name: MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL (Xiaomi FP8)
notes: Does NOT work yet on 2 × DGX Spark with the pinned image: it loads and answers with fluent nonsense (tested 2026-10-04, with the MoE on both DEEPGEMM_MXFP4 and Marlin).
